tools.name: connect
tools.description: Attempt a harmless remote hostname command from the SSH client container to one configured target. Use verbose output when useful.

tools.name: inspect_client
tools.description: Read-only inspection of effective SSH client options or Docker network attachments for the lab servers.

tools.name: inspect_server
tools.description: Read-only inspection of a lab SSH server. Returns one selected evidence view; it never changes server state.

tools.name: change_client_file_mode
tools.description: Change only the mode of an existing SSH client file in the disposable client container's mounted .ssh directory. File bytes and ownership remain unchanged. Allowed files are id_ed25519 and config; allowed modes are 0600 or 0644.

tools.name: set_proxy_jump
tools.description: Change only the ProxyJump directive in one target alias in the disposable SSH client's config. It preserves all other lines and is reversible. Choose only after observing a connectivity problem.

tools.name: change_sshd_directive
tools.description: Change one allowlisted SSH daemon directive in a lab server's configuration. It preserves all other lines, validates the resulting configuration, and can reload sshd without recreating the container. Use only when server evidence supports the exact change.

tools.name: change_file_mode
tools.description: Change only the POSIX mode of a permitted file in one lab server. The file contents and owner remain unchanged. Allowed paths are /home/deploy/.ssh and /home/deploy/.ssh/authorized_keys; allowed modes are 0700, 0600, or 0644. Use only when collected evidence supports the change.

tools.name: append_client_public_key
tools.description: Append the SSH client's public key to one lab server's authorized_keys without replacing or removing existing entries. It is a no-op if that key is already present, and reports before/after hashes and whether all previous bytes were preserved.

tools.name: add_permit_open_destination
tools.description: Add one specific host:port to a lab server's existing SSH PermitOpen allowlist. Existing destinations and all other configuration lines are preserved; sshd_config is validated and reloaded without restarting the container.

tools.name: enable_client_key_port_forwarding
tools.description: Enable TCP port forwarding for the client's existing public-key entry in one server's authorized_keys. It changes only that entry's option field, preserving the key, comments, other lines, file owner, and mode.

tools.name: remove_client_key_forced_command
tools.description: Remove only a command= restriction from the client's existing public-key entry on one lab server. The key, comments, any other key options, other entries, file owner, and file mode are preserved.

tools.description: Attempt a harmless remote hostname command from the SSH client container to one configured target. Use verbose output when useful.
tools.name: connect

tools.description: Read-only inspection of effective SSH client options or Docker network attachments for the lab servers.
tools.name: inspect_client

tools.description: Read-only inspection of a lab SSH server. Returns one selected evidence view; it never changes server state.
tools.name: inspect_server

tools.description: Change only the mode of an existing SSH client file in the disposable client container's mounted .ssh directory. File bytes and ownership remain unchanged. Allowed files are id_ed25519 and config; allowed modes are 0600 or 0644.
tools.name: change_client_file_mode

tools.description: Change only the ProxyJump directive in one target alias in the disposable SSH client's config. It preserves all other lines and is reversible. Choose only after observing a connectivity problem.
tools.name: set_proxy_jump

tools.description: Change one allowlisted SSH daemon directive in a lab server's configuration. It preserves all other lines, validates the resulting configuration, and can reload sshd without recreating the container. Use only when server evidence supports the exact change.
tools.name: change_sshd_directive

tools.description: Change only the POSIX mode of a permitted file in one lab server. The file contents and owner remain unchanged. Allowed paths are /home/deploy/.ssh and /home/deploy/.ssh/authorized_keys; allowed modes are 0700, 0600, or 0644. Use only when collected evidence supports the change.
tools.name: change_file_mode

tools.description: Append the SSH client's public key to one lab server's authorized_keys without replacing or removing existing entries. It is a no-op if that key is already present, and reports before/after hashes and whether all previous bytes were preserved.
tools.name: append_client_public_key

tools.description: Add one specific host:port to a lab server's existing SSH PermitOpen allowlist. Existing destinations and all other configuration lines are preserved; sshd_config is validated and reloaded without restarting the container.
tools.name: add_permit_open_destination

tools.description: Enable TCP port forwarding for the client's existing public-key entry in one server's authorized_keys. It changes only that entry's option field, preserving the key, comments, other lines, file owner, and mode.
tools.name: enable_client_key_port_forwarding

tools.description: Remove only a command= restriction from the client's existing public-key entry on one lab server. The key, comments, any other key options, other entries, file owner, and file mode are preserved.
tools.name: remove_client_key_forced_command
